description: Unilever está contratando Jefe de Mantenimiento Beauty & Wellbeing. ¿QUIÉNES SOMOS? ¿Quieres ser parte de una compañía que hace la diferencia alrededor del mundo? En Unilever, tenemos un propósito claro - Iluminar la vida diaria de las personas a través de sus productos y servicios, así como también promover un estilo de vida sustentable -. A través de nuestras 400 marcas que llegan a 2.5 mil millones de personas todos los días, nuestro objetivo es generar un impacto social positivo a nivel mundial y local. Estamos buscando un Jefe de Mantenimiento para nuestra unidad de negocio de Beauty & Wellbeing en la Planta Tortuguitas . PROPÓSITO DE LA POSICIÓN El Jefe de Mantenimiento B&W es responsable de supervisar y coordinar todas las actividades relacionadas con el mantenimiento y la optimización de las áreas empaque de producción asociadas a la BU. Su objetivo principal es asegurar el funcionamiento eficiente y continuo de los equipos y sistemas, manteniendo los mismos en sus condiciones óptimas de funcionamiento, minimizando el tiempo de inactividad, garantizando la calidad y seguridad en las operaciones, según estándares de Unilever. Es agente de cambio en el sector de mantenimiento liderando la mejora continua con nuestra metodología UMS, analizando e implementando mejoras para aumentar la eficiencia de los equipos, reduciendo también costos. LAS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES SERÁN: Seguridad Asegurar que todas las actividades de mantenimiento se realicen de acuerdo con las normativas de seguridad y medio ambiente de la compañía. Implementar y seguir procedimientos para garantizar la seguridad del personal y la integridad de los equipos. Asegurar la implementación de las acciones necesarias para el cumplimiento de los estándares de Machinery Safety, SHE29 y Redbook. Gestión de Mantenimiento, Planificación y Ejecución Gestionar y liderar el plantel de mecánicos/eléctricos de turno y preventivo, para que cubra con las necesidades demandadas por el sector. description: Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Experience leading maintenance technicians, technical teams, or cross-functional improvement initiatives. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable improvements. description: Job Description Job Title: GDT Data Solution Architect Location: Bangalore, India ABOUT UNILEVER: Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future. Background: For Unilever to remain competitive in the future, the business needs to continue the path to becoming data intelligent. The Global Digital & Technology team will empower Unilever’s journey to becoming an Intelligent Enterprise - powering key decisions with data, insights, advanced analytics, and AI. Our ambition is to enable democratization of data, information and insights as a completely agile organization that builds fantastic careers for our people and is accountable for delivering great work that maximizes impact and delivers growth. We would be accountable for impact of solutions, maintaining market relevance and driving P&L, customer, and consumer value from analytics products. You’ll collaborate with global product and technical teams, business stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to ensure successful project execution. Role Overview: (4 to 9 Years of experience) We are seeking a Data Solution Architect to drive the end-to-end design and development of data and analytics products within the Data Foundation ecosystem. This role spans across data platforms, BI, data lakes, data warehousing, web applications, ETL pipelines, and AI-driven solutions, ensuring that all solutions are scalable, governed, and AI-ready. As a key technical leader, you will be responsible for architecting integrated data solutions, enabling intelligent decision-making, and preparing enterprise data assets for advanced analytics and AI consumption. This role requires strong expertise across Azure and GCP ecosystems, along with a deep understanding of modern data and AI architecture patterns, including agentic and generative AI solutions. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Solution Architecture Design and own holistic data and analytics architectures covering: Data ingestion, processing, and transformation (ETL/ELT) Data lakes, data warehouses, and semantic layers BI and reporting solutions (Power BI, dashboards, datasets) Web applications and data-driven products Define scalable, modular, and reusable architecture patterns aligned to Data Foundation standards. Ensure solutions are cost-efficient, performant, and future-ready, supporting enterprise-scale use cases. Data Platform & Engineering Excellence Architect and optimise data pipelines and workflows for reliability, scalability, and maintainability. Drive standardisation across UDL, BDL, and product data layers, ensuring minimal redundancy and efficient data flow. Establish best practices for data modelling, partitioning, incremental processing, and performance optimisation. Enable self-service data capabilities through governed, well-structured data models. AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement Design solutions that make data AI-ready, including semantic modelling, metadata enrichment, and knowledge layers. Lead the adoption of AI/ML and generative AI patterns, including: Agentic architectures and multi-agent workflows RAG-based and conversational analytics solutions Apply best practices for AI governance, accuracy, monitoring, and responsible AI adoption. Cloud & Cross-Platform Architecture Build and guide solutions across Azure and Google Cloud (GCP) ecosystems. Define integration strategies across Databricks, cloud-native services, and third-party tools. Ensure solutions align with enterprise cloud strategy, security standards, and platform governance. Business & Product Alignment Partner with business stakeholders to shape data products and analytics use cases. Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs and deliverable architectures. Drive end-to-end ownership from concept to delivery and adoption, ensuring measurable business impact. Leadership & Governance Act as a technical authority and mentor, guiding engineering teams and ensuring alignment to best practices. Lead architecture reviews, enforce data governance, security, and compliance standards. Document architecture patterns, design decisions, and reusable frameworks for enterprise adoption. Required Skills & Experience Core Technical Expertise (Strong Hands-on) Strong hands-on experience in Python with ability to build production-grade data and AI solutions. Deep expertise in Databricks ecosystem, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and workflow orchestration. Advanced proficiency in SQL / PostgreSQL, with strong data modelling and optimisation skills. Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration and scheduling. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, including Cloud Run and cloud-native architectures. Strong experience in Power BI development, including semantic modelling and performance optimisation. Proven expertise in GCP architecture and solution design, delivering scalable and enterprise-ready systems. Secondary / Cross-Platform Expertise Good hands-on experience and working knowledge of: Azure ecosystem (ADF, Azure SQL, MS SQL Server) Data integration and pipeline design using ADF or equivalent tools Understanding of multi-cloud architecture patterns (Azure + GCP) and interoperability across platforms. Application & Product Development Experience in web application architecture design, including API-first and microservices-based patterns. Hands-on experience in at least one modern web/backend stack: Node.js / React .NET Python (FastAPI or similar frameworks) Ability to design and build data-driven applications and scalable backend services. AI, Data & Agentic Architecture Strong understanding of AI/ML solution design, including data preparation for AI consumption. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar. Experience building agent-driven or conversational AI solutions (RAG, orchestration, workflow agents). Understanding of event-driven architectures, APIs, and distributed systems. Knowledge of data security, governance, and access control, especially in AI/agentic architectures. Software Engineering & Delivery Strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing and delivering production-grade systems. Proven ability to: Translate architecture into working code Build scalable, modular, and maintainable solutions Experience with microservices and distributed system design patterns. Preferred Experience Experience in building data and analytics products across: Data lakes / Lakehouse architectures Data warehousing BI and reporting platforms Exposure to AI-driven or agentic solutions in enterprise environments. Experience working in data-intensive or digital-first organisations (e.g., media, analytics, or platform companies). Cultural Fit Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements. Collaborative mindset with a focus on solving real business problems. Good to Have / Preferred Skills Certification in GCP Architecture (e.g., Google Professional Cloud Architect) Additional certifications in Azure Data / AI / Architecture (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer) Exposure to Databricks certifications or advanced training in Lakehouse architecture Experience with end-to-end AI product development lifecycle, including experimentation to productionisation Familiarity with Azure DevOps / CI-CD practices for data and AI solutions Knowledge of data governance frameworks and enterprise data cataloguing tools Experience working in large-scale enterprise data transformation or cloud migration initiatives Exposure to modern data stack tools and emerging AI platforms Note: All official offers from Unilever are issued only via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). title: Continuous Improvement Manager
description: Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and foodservice platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027. JOB PURPOSE At Unilever, every improvement made on the factory floor helps deliver trusted brands into millions of homes around the world. As our Continuous Improvement Manager, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating the performance, capabilities, and competitive advantage of the factory responsible for producing Knorr® , one of the world's most recognized food brands. This is more than a continuous improvement role. It is a strategic leadership opportunity to transform how the factory operates by embedding a culture of operational excellence, capability building, and relentless loss elimination. You will work directly with site leadership, engineering, operations, and global stakeholders to unlock breakthrough improvements in productivity, reliability, quality, and cost while developing the next generation of manufacturing talent. Leveraging World Class Manufacturing (WCM) and Unilever Manufacturing System (UMS) methodologies, you will lead the site's transformation agenda, helping create a safer, smarter, and more agile operation capable of meeting the needs of consumers for years to come. Success in this role will be measured not simply by performance metrics, but by your ability to build sustainable systems, develop people, and create a culture where continuous improvement becomes part of how work gets done every day. WHAT YOU'LL DO Lead the Manufacturing Transformation Agenda Develop and execute the site's Manufacturing Excellence Master Plan, aligning business priorities with long-term performance and capability goals. Champion the deployment and maturity of World Class Manufacturing (WCM) and UMS systems across the factory. Partner with site leadership to identify strategic opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and drive sustainable business results. Serve as a key advisor and change leader during major transformation initiatives. Drive Continuous Improvement & Performance Excellence Lead site-wide loss analysis and elimination efforts across safety, quality, productivity, reliability, and cost. Deliver measurable improvements in key performance indicators including OEE, Manufacturing Performance (MP), Output Reliability (OR), and Cost per Tonne (CPT). Establish a disciplined governance process that drives accountability and ensures continuous delivery of improvement initiatives. Identify and implement best practices, emerging technologies, and innovative manufacturing solutions. Build a High-Performing, Future-Ready Organization Create and sustain a culture where continuous improvement, problem solving, and operational excellence are embedded into daily work. Coach leaders, managers, and frontline teams in Lean, WCM, and structured problem-solving methodologies. Lead capability-building strategies that strengthen technical expertise and accelerate organizational performance. Develop site maturity roadmaps that move the factory toward world-class manufacturing benchmarks. Elevate Workforce Capability & Training Excellence Lead the site's Manufacturing Training Platform and capability development strategy. Ensure learning systems, certification processes, and technical development programs directly support operational priorities and loss elimination goals. Drive adoption of modern learning methods, digital tools, structured certification pathways, and skills-based development frameworks. Partner closely with HR and global learning teams to build a highly capable and adaptable workforce. Influence Across the Business Collaborate with Site Leadership, Supply Unit Directors, Engineering, R&D, and Global MANEX teams to align operational and innovation priorities. Provide strategic guidance to Category Engineering to ensure manufacturing excellence principles are incorporated into future technologies and innovations. Champion the sharing of best practices across factories and regions, helping scale successful approaches throughout the network. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree required; Master's Degree preferred (Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or related field). 5+ years of manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, continuous improvement, or operational excellence experience. Demonstrated success leading large-scale performance improvement initiatives and delivering measurable business results. Deep expertise in Manufacturing Excellence, Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, WCM, TPM, or related operational excellence methodologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to convert insights into action. Proven ability to influence leaders and drive change within complex manufacturing environments. Exceptional coaching, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Ability to balance long-term transformational strategy with day-to-day operational execution. Preferred Qualifications Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (or equivalent). Experience leading Manufacturing Excellence, Continuous Improvement, WCM, TPM, or Operational Excellence programs within a consumer goods, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, or high-speed manufacturing environment. Pay: The pay range for this position is $103,000 to $154,400. Unilever takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. Bonus: This position is bonus eligible. Long-Term Incentive (LTI) : This position is LTI eligible. Benefits : Unilever employees are eligible to participate in our benefits plan. title: Senior Assistant Brand Manager Cooking Aids – Europe
description: Note: Deadline for applying is 23.59 the day before the Job Posting End Date. UNILEVER IS HIRING Foods - Senior Assistant Brand Manager Cooking Aids – Europe Full-time position Location: Rotterdam, The Netherlands Local conditions apply The role will be closed once the best match is found even before the posting end date Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and foodservice platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027. For the recruitment of this position, we would like to emphasize that local conditions apply to the position and for this vacancy in principle we will first consider candidates based in the Netherlands. If you are based outside of the Netherlands and you are interested to apply, please feel free to do so but we can only take your application on if a decision is made to also recruit outside of the Netherlands. ABOUT UNILEVER With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: brighten everyday life for all, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future. Foods Europe is Unilever’s biggest BU with over 2.4B TO, playing across key verticals Condiments, Cooking Aids and Mini-Meals, behind Billion Euro Global Brands Knorr and Hellmann’s and local jewels like Maille, Amora, Pot Noodle, Marmite, etc. ABOUT COOKING AIDS & KNORR At Knorr, we believe every home cook deserves the confidence to create a delicious meal, regardless of how much time, skill or inspiration they have. For nearly 200 years, Knorr has helped people bring flavour, convenience and care into everyday cooking. Today, Cooking Aids is at the heart of Knorr’s growth ambition in Europe. Guided by our promise “We Got You”, we are on a transformation journey to reignite category growth by helping consumers create flavourful meals with confidence — through products that are easy to find, easy to choose and easy to use. To unlock future growth, we are reshaping our portfolio towards faster-growing spaces, building new consumption occasions and creating breakthrough innovation platforms across priority growth areas. Within this strategy, Meal Solutions and Seasonings are key priority segments. They offer an exciting opportunity to shape the future of everyday cooking in Europe: building distinctive propositions, scaling strong innovation platforms, and creating brand experiences that help more people cook with confidence every day. JOB PURPOSE This is an exciting opportunity to join the Cooking Aids Marketing team, part of Foods Europe, Unilever’s biggest Business Unit. You will be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team that values creativity, curiosity, pace and collaboration. The role sits within the Platform & Innovation team, which is part of the broader Cooking Aids Marketing team. In this role, you will work across key priority segments, Meal Solutions and Seasonings especially, supporting the development and delivery of innovation, renovation, portfolio choices and brand activation plans across Europe. You will play a key role in bringing Knorr’s growth agenda to life: leading projects end to end, supporting big innovation bets, partnering with markets and cross-functional teams, and helping connect portfolio strategy with strong consumer-facing communication and activations. This is a great role for a marketer who enjoys both crafting and execution: someone who can bring structure to innovation projects, understand consumer and market needs, work closely with local markets, and contribute to brand-building work that makes our propositions more distinctive, relevant and impactful. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES End-to-end project leadership: Take ownership, lead and project manage innovation, renovation and savings initiatives, working closely with cross-functional and country teams to bring products to market OTIF. This will require strong project management skills, clear ownership and the ability to build strong relationships across functions and markets. Support key European innovation big bets: Play an active role in delivering priority innovation projects across Meal Solutions and Seasonings, helping shape strong propositions, manage project milestones and ensure the right level of focus, pace and quality from idea to market launch. Drive excellence in innovation delivery: Help bring innovation to market quickly and effectively, including creation of 100-day reviews and Post-Launch Evaluations, managing project budgets and adopting the Innoflex mindset when planning consumer research and testing. Help modernise Knorr for contemporary cooks: Support the development of new concepts and propositions that are exciting, on-trend and help drive relevance, penetration and long-term growth for the brand. We are looking for creativity, curiosity and a can-do mindset. Support EU Platform strategy and growth plans: Support the EU Platform team in developing and implementing share-winning category strategies, leveraging category understanding, food trends and changing consumer eating habits to identify future growth opportunities. Support EU Brand Experience work across communication campaigns and activations: Support the EU Brand Experience team to ensure key portfolio and innovation priorities are translated into strong communication campaigns, activations and consumer experiences. Act as a connector across markets and functions: Drive day-to-day contact with local markets to support them in bringing category plans and innovation projects to life. Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (CMI, R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, CSP and Brand Experience) to unlock opportunities, drive projects forward and ensure strong execution. WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED You are a strong marketer with a passion for food, brands and consumers. You enjoy working across both innovation and brand experience, and you are energised by turning ideas into plans that can land in market with impact. You bring structure to complex projects, are comfortable working across different markets and functions, and know how to keep momentum when priorities move quickly. You are curious about consumer behaviour, food trends and what makes brands distinctive. You are pragmatic and able to balance creativity with execution, combining strong project leadership with a hands-on mindset to turn opportunities into action and deliver results. EXPERIENCE & SKILLS 3+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in portfolio management, innovation and/or brand management. Experience or strong exposure to brand experience, communication campaigns and/or activations. Proven track record in project management, ideally including innovation, renovation or cross-functional launch projects. Ability to work independently and lead cross-functional project teams with clarity and ownership. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across European markets, functions and levels of seniority. Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations. Curiosity for food, flavour, cooking habits and consumer trends. Positive mindset, high energy and a fast-learning attitude. Previous experience in Foods or FMCG is a plus. MINDSET & BEHAVIOURS Growth-oriented: You look for opportunities to unlock growth, improve the portfolio and move the category forward. Consumer and brand curious: You start from consumer needs and are interested in how innovation, communication and activation come together to build stronger brands. Collaborative: You build strong relationships across markets and functions and know how to bring people with you. Owner mentality: You take accountability, drive momentum and follow through from idea to execution. Agile and resilient: You are comfortable with ambiguity, can manage several priorities at once and keep energy and focus in a fast-moving environment. WHAT SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE Success in this role means you are recognised as a strong project leader and trusted partner across the Cooking Aids team. You help land priority innovation projects with pace and quality, support the development of future growth opportunities across Meal Solutions and Seasonings, and contribute to stronger links between portfolio priorities, communication campaigns and market activation. You will help bring clarity, structure and momentum to key workstreams, while building the skills and experience needed to grow towards broader brand and category leadership roles in the future. EXCITED? Join Unilever and our team! To apply, you must do so online. Please do not forget to upload your CV and a motivation letter. Your application will be reviewed against our requirements, and we will be in touch shortly after the closing date to provide you with an update on the status of your application. Looking forward to meeting you! Please note this is a Direct Search led by Unilever. Applications from agencies will not be accepted, nor will fees be paid for unsolicited CVs. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, age, parenthood, pregnancy or any other basis protected by applicable law, and will not be discriminated against. description: TRADE MARKETING ANALYST (FOOD SOLUTIONS) Function: Customer Development / Trade Marketing Scope: Food Solutions – Trade Marketing Investments & Commercial Agreements Location: Bogota A principios de este año (marzo de 2026), Unilever anunció un acuerdo para separar su negocio de Alimentos. Asegurar la trazabilidad completa de los acuerdos comerciales desde la negociación hasta su liquidación. Validar la correcta ejecución de las condiciones comerciales acordadas versus la implementación real con los clientes. Administrar la parametrización de descuentos, rebates y condiciones comerciales dentro de los sistemas correspondientes. Garantizar que las condiciones negociadas se encuentren correctamente reflejadas en la operación y sistemas. Identificar y corregir inconsistencias que puedan generar riesgos financieros, errores operativos o fugas de margen. Construir y gestionar el phasing de inversión comercial en línea con los objetivos financieros y comerciales del negocio. Monitorear la ejecución mensual de inversiones versus plan, identificando y anticipando desviaciones. Apoyar la correcta distribución y control del gasto promocional a lo largo del período. Brindar soporte analítico a los planes de crecimiento con clientes y canales. Evaluar el retorno sobre la inversión (ROI) de actividades comerciales y promociones. Experiencia en gestión y control de inversiones comerciales, promociones, descuentos o acuerdos con clientes. Conocimiento sólido de procesos financieros, conciliaciones, notas de crédito y seguimiento presupuestal. Experiencia trabajando de manera colaborativa con equipos multifuncionales como Ventas, Finanzas y Trade Marketing. Nice to Have Experiencia en la industria de consumo masivo (FMCG). title: Transport Excellence Leader
description: Unilever está contratando Transport Excellence Leader ¿QUIÉNES SOMOS? ¿Quieres ser parte de una compañía que hace la diferencia alrededor del mundo? En Unilever, tenemos un propósito claro - Iluminar la vida diaria de las personas a través de sus productos y servicios, así como también promover un estilo de vida sustentable -. A través de nuestras 400 marcas que llegan a 2.5 mil millones de personas todos los días, nuestro objetivo es generar un impacto social positivo a nivel mundial y local. Estamos buscando Transport Excellence Leader para el área de Transporte. PROPÓSITO DE LA POSICIÓN Liderar la estrategia y ejecución del transporte de Unilever Argentina en sus dos etapas críticas: la logística primaria, que conecta nuestras fábricas con el centro de distribución, y la logística secundaria, que lleva el producto desde el CD hasta más de 300 clientes en más de 600 sucursales a lo largo y ancho del país. El rol tiene impacto directo en el nivel de servicio al cliente, en la eficiencia del costo logístico y en la transformación del modelo operativo de transporte. Es el puente entre la estrategia y la operación diaria, liderando la mejora continua y el desarrollo de proyectos que evolucionan la forma en que Unilever opera su logística. LAS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES SERÁN: Liderar la planificación y ejecución del transporte primario, asegurando los correctos retiros en plantas y 3PM para garantizar la disponibilidad de stock en el CD. Liderar la ejecución del transporte secundario, asegurando la entrega de producto en tiempo y forma. Monitorear y gestionar los indicadores clave de la operación (OTD, OTA, costo por viaje), identificando desvíos y liderando planes de mejora continua. Construir y mantener el árbol de pérdida logístico, identificando causas raíz de incumplimiento y generando acciones correctivas con los responsables internos y externos. Liderar reuniones de performance con transportistas, exigiendo compromisos concretos y haciendo seguimiento de su ejecución. Impulsar proyectos de innovación y transformación operativa que mejoren la eficiencia, reduzcan costos y eleven el nivel de servicio. Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad vial en toda la operación, gestionando auditorías, seguimiento de choferes y protocolos de sanción. Aumentar la visibilidad de la operación mediante herramientas digitales, dashboards y sistemas de seguimiento en tiempo real. Identificar oportunidades de ahorro y eficiencia en el costo de transporte, traduciendo mejoras operativas en impacto económico medible. Gestionar el presupuesto de transporte, monitoreando desvíos y asegurando su cumplimiento a lo largo del año. Dar soporte en los procesos de licitación con proveedores de transporte, definiendo modelos de scoring, estándares de servicio y esquemas de penalidades y bonificaciones. Articular con Customer Service, Operaciones, Compras y Finanzas para garantizar una operación end-to-end alineada y sin fricciones. Liderar y desarrollar el equipo a cargo, promoviendo una cultura de mejora continua, orientación al servicio y ejecución con foco en resultados. ¿QUÉ NECESITAS PARA APLICAR A LA VACANTE? Experiencia en Logística / Supply Chain / Planning (Deseable). Experiencia trabajando con operaciones tercerizadas o modelos regionales (deseable). Experiencia liderando equipos. Orientación a resultados con foco simultáneo en servicio, costo y eficiencia operativa. Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de tomar decisiones basadas en datos en contextos de alta complejidad. Liderazgo con y sin autoridad directa. Capacidad de negociación y construcción de relaciones de confianza con proveedores y stakeholders internos. Mentalidad de mejora continua e innovación. title: Associate Director, Channel Strategy Planning & Operations Cooking Aids & Mini Meals US
description: JOB PURPOSE The Category Strategy & Planning (CS&P) organization leads category strategy, channel and customer planning, and category and shopper insights for the U.S. CA&MM (Cooking Aids & Meal Makers business within the Foods Business Unit. This role is a leadership position with responsibility for overseeing Category Strategy & Planning across the Cooking Aids & Mini Meals Portfolio, primarily including Knorr Bouillon, Meal Makers Ready to Heat/ Non Ready to Heat, Soups Gravy and Sauces. The Category Planning function partners closely with Field Sales, Business Development, Category Strategy, Category Management, Marketing (Demand Creation, Innovation, Shopper,) Finance, Net Revenue Management, Supply Chain, and Trade Marketing to develop a commercial strategy and execution levers via Omni & Pureplay retailer plans through flawless execution that delivers category growth and meets U.S. Cooking Aids & Mini Meals total P&L growth targets.. The Associate Director, Category Strategy & Planning – Cooking Aids & Mini Meals will serve as the voice of the customer and shopper within the cross functional Cooking Aids & Mini Meals leadership team, ensuring channel and customer insights are embedded into short and long term brand and customer commercial plans that align with retailer strategies and deliver profitable growth for both Unilever and its customers. Find your purpose at Unilever. You will lead innovations, big and small, that will make our business win and grow. You will learn from brilliant business leaders and colleagues in a truly global and diverse culture to ultimately become a better you. If you are driven by commercial acumen, like winning and are passionate about growing categories with customers then this role is just for you. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES: Lead profitable growth for the U.S. CA&MM business, bringing an entrepreneurial, challenger mindset to ignite competitive performance and accelerate category momentum. Output to: In-Year Performance market share assessment, S&OP pacing risk and opportunity Translate data into insight and insight into action by developing and executing robust commercial plans aligned to the Category Growth Strategy and key Category Value Drivers. Output to: Multi-year planning (One Plan), Commercialization input (innovation & PPA) Lead delivery of the out-year plan (partnered with Cat Strat, Marketing) into the annual release of the TCT Materials and annual Foods Summit to launch the next year planning cycle with customers. Output: TCT Materials, Foods Summit Own channel and customer financial delivery, including development of annual growth targets, trade investment budgets, and forecasts that ladder directly to the CA&MM P&L and deliver both top and bottom line KPIs. Output: OP Annual Planning Process Set and deploy channel strategy for the category, ensuring holistic, disciplined customer investment across channels and customers to drive sustainable, profitable growth. Output: Channel Strategy, OP Annual Planning Process Lead deep dive commercial analytics to research and sculpt an approach to address business opportunities such as distribution gaps, in-market execution, competitive dynamics Partner with Net Revenue Management/RGM to deliver optimal pricing/PPA and to optimize promotional effectiveness, delivering stronger ROI and enhancements to in-market execution Serve as the voice of the customer, channel, and shopper within IBP (internal) and JBP (external) processes, while also representing category and brand priorities externally with top strategic customers and internally with Business Development and Category Development Sales teams. Partner closely with field sales and cross functional teams to ensure best in class Perfect Store activation, flawless execution of national cross category and cross customer tentpole programs, and successful innovation launch planning and execution. Processes: MBR input to S&OP, Handshake, Perfect Store WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED Experiences & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred At least +10 years’ experience in Customer Development, Account Management, Trade Marketing, Category Strategy, and/or Brand Marketing Operations within Consumer Goods industry. Food experience preferred. Results-driven and ownership mindset to achieve set goals and KPIs, highly entrepreneurial Proven ability to demonstrate analytical thinking, data-driven decision making, and ability to influence through strategic story-telling Retail, eCommerce, and Omnichannel customer experience required, high level of CPG Food business industry and retailer acumen Excellent oral/written and presentation skills; ability to tailor communication style across a multitude of disciplines’ leadership levels, executive presence Energized by collaborating with cross-functional partners on new and creative ways to solve business problems; solution-focused mindset Encourages ownership to resolve issues where they are happening. Holds others and organization accountable for delivery. High comfort level using IRI/Nielsen (POS data), Numerator (panel data) Excellent Team & Organization Leadership Skills: Senior Stakeholder Management & Strategic influencing Talent Catalyst for direct reports Effective mobilizer of cross functional partnerships Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, comfortable adapting to dynamic environments applying mix of personal analysis and delegation Passion for High Performance to over-deliver against assigned targets while managing ambiguity- addressing market volatility with an agile mindset to find creative solutions to achieve results Ability to envision and plan multi-year, understanding long-term and broad-reaching impact of decisions made today. title: Associate Director, Media Procurement
description: Background & Purpose of the Job We operate at the forefront of competitive buying, sustainable sourcing and purpose-led partnerships. We seek to combine our own technology expertise and insights with our partners, to support the creation of disruptive sourcing strategies and supplier-led innovation that respond to ever-changing consumer needs quickly, flexibly and effectively. ABOUT UNILEVER PROCUREMENT Part of the Supply Chain family, Unilever Procurement is responsible for over 30B Euro spend of material and services spend globally with more than 50,000 suppliers. Getting the right services and materials, sustainably sourced and ensuring responsible procurement is critical to ensuring our brands with purpose grow. Our teams work closely with the business to understand stakeholders needs, bring innovation to meet changing consumer, employees and customers needs, and drive financial value for Unilever through competitive buying. We are at the forefront of digital procurement, bringing new tools and analytics to drive data-based decisions. ABOUT Marketing Procurement Marketing procurement is responsible for Unilever’s sourcing and supplier strategy and execution for all third party spend across Marketing supporting the business requirements of Brands, Business Units, Business Groups, and functions to drive growth through strategic supplier management, cost and value management, sustainability and innovation. The team manages an annual spend of ~6B Euro. Within Marketing Procurement, The Global Strategy Lead will increase effectiveness of our Media procurement by creating an expertise-driven model, streamlining accountabilities, building capabilities, and leveraging knowledge, relationships, and business strategies across markets, defining the future-fit strategy for media portfolio, including data and audience strategy in the media space. They will increase efficiency of our Media procurement by driving scale where it makes sense, decreasing fragmentation, pooling expertise across geographies, prioritizing higher impact spend areas, leveraging technology and data, and drive performance that unlocks 4G growth for Unilever. The role will foster and build a culture of collaboration and agility to enable an efficient project roll out. It will ensure close alignment in strategy with Marketing Procurement directors and Business Group Procurement Directors by defining and utilizing a robust support network for the whole team and providing clarity on the ways of works and roles and responsibilities. Key Accountabilities: • Understand the business needs and bring deep expertise and insights across the value chain and supply base to translate the business requirements into effective future-fit procurement strategies. • Develop global sourcing strategy in demand creation (including influencer amplification), data and audience building related to media. • Role will also be key end to end priorities, aligned with Procurement strategies and principles • Deliver transformational sourcing strategies, operating models, and supplier relationships to redefine our procurement approach to media spend to drive growth in accordance with our plans. • Deliver against financial targets and other KPIs (including value delivery) as per business plan objectives, accountable for delivery of portfolio and scope • Support internal performance management and reporting including creation and stewardship of relevant key performance indicators Experience Required: Qualification/experience • title: Coordenador(a) de Business Analytics, Data and Performance
description: Junte-se a nós como Coordenador(a) de Business Analytics, Data and Performance PROPÓSITO DA VAGA Esta função existe para Atuar como referência técnica e de governança analítica em dados de sell-out, shopper e performance de mercado, garantindo qualidade de dados, profundidade analítica e geração de insights acionáveis , suportando decisões estratégicas e táticas de CSP, Marketing, CBD e demais áreas do negócio, além de contribuir ativamente para a evolução da agenda de dados da Unilever. Você fará parte de uma equipe que acredita em realizar um trabalho que importa — para as pessoas e para o planeta. Porque aqui, não contratamos apenas para vagas. Convidamos você a fazer parte de algo maior. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES A. Análises de Sell-Out e Performance de Mercado Desenvolver análises aprofundadas de sell-out, utilizando múltiplas fontes e visões (incluindo Trade Stock, análises de sensibilidade e derivados), com foco em: Geração de insights Resposta a perguntas de negócio Suporte a decisões estratégicas e táticas Atuar tanto em demandas solicitadas pelo negócio quanto de forma proativa, identificando oportunidades, riscos e desvios não previamente mapeados. Produzir análises em diferentes níveis de granularidade (mercado, categoria, marca, canal, cliente e região). B. Análises Avançadas de Shopper Desenvolver análises baseadas em dados de shopper (AIV), explorando comportamentos que não podem ser inferidos apenas por dados de CNPJ, tais como: Análises de cesta de compras Fidelidade e lealdade de shopper Trocas entre marcas, categorias ou formatos Missão de compra e comportamento por ocasião Traduzir aprendizados de shopper em recomendações claras para Marketing, CSP e estratégia comercial. C. Análises de Mídia e Promoções Desenvolver análises para mensurar a efetividade de campanhas de mídia e ações promocionais, avaliando impactos em: Volume, valor e share Distribuição, giro e execução Sinergias ou canibalizações entre produtos Apoiar decisões futuras de investimento e priorização de ações. D. Análises Estatísticas e Modelagem Realizar análises estatísticas avançadas para: Projeções de mercado, categoria e produto Identificação de correlações e interações entre produtos ou alavancas Cálculo de elasticidades de preço e outros indicadores estatísticos relevantes Apoiar a tomada de decisão com modelos quantitativos robustos e bem documentados. E. Validação e Qualidade dos Dados de Sell-Out Atuar como responsável funcional pela validação semanal dos dados de sell-out, após as validações técnicas, garantindo: Consistência dos dados entregues Identificação de erros de processamento ou origem Mitigação de impactos nos reports e análises do negócio Documentar e comunicar desvios relevantes aos times responsáveis. F. Governança e Evolução das Bases de Dados Mapear impactos, validar e homologar modificações nas bases de sell-out, incluindo: Ajustes estruturais Melhorias de processo Inclusão de novos fornecedores de dados Atuar como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, garantindo aderência ao contexto e às necessidades do negócio. G. Suporte a Produtos de Dados Globais Prestar suporte técnico e funcional ao desenvolvimento e evolução de produtos de dados globais (ex.: UPOSE, NRM Analytics), esclarecendo: Regras de negócio Estrutura das bases De-para’s e particularidades locais Contribuir para escalabilidade, padronização e qualidade das soluções globais. H. Criação e Governança de Produtos Analíticos (Dashboards e PBIs) Levantar com as áreas as necessidades recorrentes de acompanhamento e análise. Desenvolver e evoluir dashboards e produtos analíticos (PBIs) que: Simplifiquem análises do dia a dia Democratizem o acesso à informação Garantam consistência de métricas e conceitos Atuar como guardião da lógica de negócios embutida nesses produtos. I. Representação em Fóruns e Comunidade de Dados Representar a BU em Data Boards e comunidades de dados, com responsabilidades de: Discussão de problemas estruturais e desafios do ecossistema de dados Definição de prioridades e melhorias de processo Troca de aprendizados e boas práticas entre BUs Contribuição para decisões que impactam o futuro da agenda de dados Atuar com visão transversal, considerando impactos para múltiplas áreas e unidades de negócio. EXPERIÊNCIAS E QUALIFICAÇÕES NECESSÁRIAS Ensino Superior Completo; Conhecimento em linguagens de programação para análise de dados - Python/Pyspark, R/R spark e/ou SQL; Experiência em análise de dados aplicada ao negócio ( preferencialmente em áreas como CSP, Marketing, Customer Development ou similares); Excel avançado; Conhecimento em análises estatísticas e modelagens básicas/intermediárias (ex.: correlação, regressão, elasticidade de preço); Experiência com dados de sell-out e/ou shopper , incluindo interpretação de métricas de mercado (share, distribuição, preço, volume, etc.); Habilidade de uso da IA para acelerar ou simplificar a montagem de análises, geração de insights e para auxiliar o time na integração dela para melhorar processos do dia a dia; Inglês avançado; Conhecimentos sólidos de PowerBI. EXPERIÊNCIAS E QUALIFICAÇÕES DESEJÁVEIS Experiência atuando em ambientes multifuncionais , com interface entre diferentes áreas do negócio; Experiência com desenvolvimento de produtos de dados (dashboards, trackers, soluções analíticas estruturadas). Todos os candidatos receberão consideração justa e respeitosa, e apoiamos ativamente o crescimento e desenvolvimento de cada colaborador. description: MAIN JOB PURPOSE The range of Basic Operator roles varies between categories and technologies, but generally sits within the Mixer, Packer, Palletiser, Production Ancillary and Sealer Job Families. Amenable to work in General Trias, Cavite Preferred/Desirable: Experience of manufacturing in a Fast-Moving Consumer Goods Company is desirable but not essential. IT Skills – competent in the use of Microsoft Office; Excel and Word programmes is preferred. description: About Pepsi Lipton Pepsi Lipton is a unique joint venture between Unilever and PepsiCo, combining over 125 years of tea expertise to pioneer the global ready-to-drink tea category. As an autonomous global business, we develop and launch products worldwide, offering broad exposure and opportunities to shape the future of beverages. Our teams are passionate about unlocking the power of tea and pushing the boundaries of innovation from science to sensory to deliver exciting, high-quality products that reach millions of consumers globally. This role combines hands-on development expertise with the ability to build and strengthen technical capabilities across key strategic areas. Own formulation design and technical problem-solving, translating briefs into robust, scalable product solutions. Build and apply technical expertise in key areas: milk tea, functional ingredients, and fresh brew tea processing. A pessoa atuará como elo entre a estratégia da companhia e a rotina prática do time em campo, impulsionando performance, desenvolvimento da equipe e melhoria contínua dos processos comerciais. Nesta função, você fará parte de um time que acredita em construir relações sólidas com clientes, transformar oportunidades em resultados e gerar impacto positivo para o negócio, para as pessoas e para o planeta. Se você gosta de liderar pessoas, acompanhar indicadores, estar próximo(a) da operação e contribuir diretamente para o crescimento de marcas presentes no dia a dia de milhões de consumidores, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade. Capacidade de analisar indicadores de desempenho, identificar oportunidades e propor planos de ação com foco em melhoria de resultados. Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e gestão, como Excel intermediário/avançado e Power BI, para construção de relatórios e acompanhamento de performance. Perfil resiliente, colaborativo e orientado a resultados, com habilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e sob pressão. CNH categoria B definitiva e ativa. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs. These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate. How is Unilever tackling this? Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down. What can I do? If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat. Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

title: Associate Director - Revenue Growth Management, Beauty & Wellbeing
description: ABOUT UNILEVER With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. This role serves as the central hub for leading the 5 levers of revenue growth 1) pricing, 2) price/pack / portfolio transformation, 3) Mix Management 4) Promo Spend and 5) Trade Terms Optimization. You will direct dock with our Marketing and CS&P teams - driving competitive growth and unlocking new opportunities and will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing and making recommendations across the levers to support the Business Unit (BU) Strategy Growth Framework and Commercial Strategy. The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills. The role will deliver best-in-class Category growth and development and deliver a sharp promo and pricing plan. title: Replenishment Analyst
description: JOB PURPOSE The Replenishment Analyst supports the Integrated Planning organization by providing the reporting, analytics, and planning visibility needed to enable strong service, inventory, and business performance across Beauty & Wellbeing North America. Working across Demand, Supply, and Replenishment Planning, this role is responsible for developing and maintaining key planning reports, scorecards, data pulls, and visualizations that provide teams with timely and accurate visibility to performance, risks, and opportunities. The Replenishment Analyst will partner closely with Demand Fulfillment Managers, Market Collaboration Planners, Replenishment Planners, Planning Operations Managers, and other planning stakeholders to understand business needs and translate data into clear, actionable information. The role combines strong analytical and technical capabilities with a working understanding of end-to-end planning processes. While the primary focus is analytics, reporting, and decision support, the Replenishment Analyst will also provide planning support and investigate service, inventory, demand, and supply exceptions as business needs arise. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Planning Analytics, Reporting & Insights Develop, maintain, and distribute recurring planning reports and scorecards across service, inventory, demand, supply, and replenishment. Perform regular and ad hoc data pulls to support business reviews, planning discussions, leadership requests, and deeper investigation of performance gaps. Track and report key planning metrics including Dispatch Rate, inventory and Days Inventory, forecast accuracy and bias, demand and supply performance, planning adherence, customer service, and other relevant KPIs. Develop reporting and analysis for excess, slow-moving, obsolete, and unhealthy inventory, including visibility to trends and potential areas requiring further action. Provide reporting and visibility to innovation, renovation, transition, and delist performance as needed. Identify trends, recurring exceptions, data anomalies, and emerging risks within planning data and bring them forward to the appropriate process or business owners for further assessment and action. Support root-cause investigations by gathering, organizing, and analyzing relevant data to enable process owners and planning leaders to determine drivers and appropriate actions. Create clear data visualizations, Power BI dashboards, Excel-based analysis, and PowerPoint materials that enable teams and leadership to quickly understand business performance. Maintain and continuously improve recurring reports and analytical tools, balancing manual data analysis with opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate reporting. Help establish consistent definitions, reporting methodologies, and sources of truth across Integrated Planning analytics. Replenishment & Planning Support Support Demand Fulfillment Managers, Market Collaboration Planners, Replenishment Planners, Planning Operations Managers, and other planning stakeholders with analysis required to evaluate service, inventory, demand, and supply performance. Monitor product availability and replenishment performance and provide visibility to potential service risks, inventory imbalances, and exceptions requiring attention. Support analysis of short- and mid-term supply challenges, including demand/supply gaps and service and inventory trade-offs. Partner with Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Customer Operations, and other cross-functional teams to gather information and provide analytical support for planning decisions. Provide analytical support for scenario planning and evaluation of service, inventory, and replenishment alternatives. Participate in relevant Demand-Supply, Integrated Planning, and performance review meetings, providing data and reporting support as required. Support waste prevention and inventory health activities across Finished Goods, Packaging, and Raw Materials through reporting and exception visibility. Provide analytical support for innovation, transition, portfolio, and strategic planning activities. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Success in this role will be measured through both business performance visibility and the quality of analytical support provided to the Integrated Planning organization, including: Accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of planning reports and scorecards Service / Dispatch Rate visibility and reporting Inventory and Days Inventory performance reporting Forecast Accuracy and Forecast Bias reporting Excess, obsolete, unhealthy inventory, and Business Waste visibility Demand/Supply and replenishment exception reporting Planning adherence and in-month delivery visibility Timeliness and quality of ad hoc analysis and leadership requests Effectiveness and adoption of dashboards, reporting tools, and standardized analytics Continuous improvement and simplification of recurring reporting processes WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 2–3 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain, Planning, Customer Service, Inventory Planning, Replenishment, Analytics, or a related field. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to manipulate, analyze, and summarize large datasets. Experience developing clear and effective PowerPoint presentations and communicating data visually. Experience with Power BI, data visualization, or dashboard development strongly preferred. Experience with planning and ERP systems such as RapidResponse and SAP ECC is preferred but not required. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and an ability to recognize trends, anomalies, and gaps within complex datasets. Ability to translate business questions into structured analysis and provide accurate, timely information to support decision-making. Ability to independently investigate issues, gather relevant information, and structure findings for review by planning and business leaders. Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage recurring reporting responsibilities alongside ad hoc analytical requests. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across Demand, Supply, Replenishment, Customer Operations, and other cross-functional teams. Continuous improvement mindset with an interest in simplifying, standardizing, and improving how planning information is generated and communicated. title: Customer Service Manager - Walmart
description: Join us as Customer Service Manager - Walmart Location: Rogers, AR Terms & Conditions: Full time, International assignment is not available for this role and relocation for local and international candidates is not provided ABOUT UNILEVER: With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. We work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. JOB PURPOSE: The Customer Supply Chain Manager is a high-visibility, customer-facing role primarily focused on managing the supply chain relationship with Walmart in a way that optimizes customer satisfaction and expectations, provides Unilever with a strategic advantage, and builds customer growth. Based on the Walmart customer team in Rogers, Arkansas, this position requires strong leadership and expertise across the team in support of Unilever's largest customer. You will own the CPFR strategy for the Consumables business, spanning Personal Care, Beauty & Wellbeing, and Home Care, and lead a team of CPFR analysts and specialists who drive optimal forecast and replenishment levels to maximize on-shelf availability across stores, clubs, and eCommerce fulfillment. This role drives end-to-end supply chain activities, helping the team meet customer in-stock and out-of-stock goals, store and distribution center inventory targets, overall sales goals, and case fill and OTIF performance. The role requires the willingness to learn Walmart's forecasting and replenishment systems and to work fluently in the customer's data environment, including Retail Link, Luminate, and Walmart's replenishment and inventory management tools, alongside Unilever tools such as Excel-based models, Power BI, Simplify, and SAP. Walmart's supplier scorecards, including OTIF and the Supplier Quality Excellence Program (SQEP), are a shared measure of success and should shape how the team prioritizes its work. These activities require tight internal and external business linkages, and strong communication skills are critical for success. The role sits at numerous interfaces, including Walmart replenishment managers, inventory analysts, and merchants, as well as Unilever Customer Development, Demand Planning, Logistics, and Category teams, and calls for strong leadership, good judgement, relationship building, and an appetite for driving continuous improvement across the Walmart and Unilever supply chain. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: A major focus is to champion adherence to supply chain best practices. description: Job Title: Demand Creation Chef Location: Taguig Reporting: Reports to the UFS Executive Chef Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and foodservice platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027. Who We Are? At Unilever Food Solutions, our purpose is to Free Chefs to love what they do. We work with Hotels, Restaurants, Caterers, Cafeterias, and Foodservice Operators to create exciting menus that are good for diners and good for the planet. Our brands include Knorr, Best Foods, and Lady’s Choice—trusted and used by chefs and foodservice operators every day. You will develop and execute business plans alongside the cross-functional team, with the objective of creating demand, supporting sales growth, increasing SKU penetration, and improving operator conversion. This role collaborates closely with Customer Development, Marketing, CD Capability, and Culinary teams to execute innovative culinary solutions that support business growth. The Demand Creation Chef is expected to professionally represent the Unilever Food Solutions brand at all times and utilize culinary expertise to influence operator adoption and increase product penetration within assigned territories. Ensure sampling activities are supported by recipes, costing, and commercial rationale to drive product acceptance and conversion. Operator Engagement & Solution Selling Work directly with foodservice operators to understand business challenges and provide practical menu and product solutions that improve profitability, efficiency, and diner satisfaction. Translate product benefits into commercial opportunities for operators. Culinary Training Support Support chefmanship and capability-building programs, including MCQT, Basic Culinary Training (BCT), Product Knowledge Transfer (PKT), and other learning interventions for operators and internal teams. Customer Relationship Management Build and maintain strong relationships with operators, distributors, and foodservice stakeholders within assigned territories. Act as a key culinary contact responsible for creating trust and driving operator loyalty. Marketing Activation Support Provide culinary support to marketing-led activations, trade shows, masterclasses, and customer events through compelling food solutions, demonstrations, and product storytelling. Product Acceptance & Conversion -Achieve defined acceptance, strike rate, and launch targets through relevant dish solutions and compelling culinary presentations. Measure success through operator adoption and menu placement. Recipe & Costing Database -Develop and maintain a comprehensive repository of operator-ready recipes, costings, product applications, and sampling concepts that support business growth objectives. Training & Capability Building -Support delivery of culinary training programs and product knowledge sessions that improve operator competence and increase UFS product adoption. Customer Relationships -Build strong customer relationships that position UFS as a trusted culinary advisor and partner for sustainable business growth. Marketing & Promotional Support -Provide culinary expertise and execution support to key marketing programs, activations, future menus, and innovation campaigns. Minimum 3–5 years of experience as a Demi Chef in a professional kitchen environment, or at least 2 years of experience as a Chef de Partie. Strong culinary fundamentals with the ability to create operator-relevant menu solutions and product applications. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Commercially minded with an understanding of food cost, menu engineering, and foodservice operations. Passion for culinary innovation, customer engagement, and continuous learning. Strong planning, organizational, and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. description: Are you ready to kick-start your career at one of the world’s most iconic companies? description: Job Purpose At Unilever, Digital and Technology is helping shape the next chapter of growth for one of the world’s leading consumer goods companies. This is an opportunity to work on the highest-value applications of technology across a North America business with scale, complexity, and global influence. You will use cutting edge technology, data, digital products, and artificial intelligence to transform how we operate, serve customers, and connect with consumers. This is a strategic business engagement role, where you will shape the North America business-led technology needs, develop the investment case, align the senior stakeholders who fund and use it, and hold the outcome. Traditional Technology Delivery roles own execution and activities but in this role, you own the translation between business outcomes and technical solutions, and the value that results. You will contribute to priority initiatives that sit on the leadership agenda, including artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities that are attracting significant investment and visibility across the business. As part of a rotational model, you will build breadth across strategic digital priorities, moving across high-impact opportunities where technology will unlock measurable value, accelerate decision-making, and strengthen competitive advantage. North America is a lighthouse market for Unilever globally, giving this role a unique platform to help prove, scale, and shape solutions that can influence the wider enterprise. You will partner across business and technology teams, translate complex needs into practical delivery, and help create smarter, faster, and more connected ways of working — while building the experience, relationships, and commercial understanding needed to grow as a digital business leader. What you will do Translate business problems into solutions. Work with sales, brand marketing, supply chain, finance and HR senior stakeholders to understand where digital, data or AI capability will deliver highest value. You own the problem definition, not just executing a brief. Build the business case and set the priorities. Develop investment cases, trade-off frameworks and sequenced roadmaps that direct capital toward the highest-impact initiatives, and secure executive alignment behind them. Turn data into commercial decisions. Drive adoption of analytics across pricing, promotion effectiveness and Revenue Growth Management, translating analysis into actions the commercial teams will take. Partner senior stakeholders. Manage day-to-day relationships with senior business and technology leaders independently, escalate trade-offs with a recommended option rather than an open question, and author the materials that steering committees decide from. Connect North America to global Digital & Technology product platforms. Drive alignment between market needs and global product and data platform capabilities, ensuring what is implemented has change management resourcing and meets NA market needs. Own adoption and realized value. Define the success measures for your workstreams, build the change and enablement plans that get people using what you deliver, and track / measure benefits realized. Work alongside global product owners and third-party partners to keep your initiatives moving, surfacing blockers and resolving the commercial decisions that unblock them What you will bring Essential: Five or more years translating commercial or consumer business problems into technology, data or AI solutions, with impact you can quantify. A background in strategy or management consulting, corporate strategy, product management or digital transformation, gained either in a consulting firm or in an in-house strategy and transformation team. Experience in consumer goods, retail or another consumer-facing industry, whether as an operator or as a consultant serving those sectors. Executive-ready communication: you can author the paper a steering committee decides from, and also hold the room when it is discussed. Comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities and matrixed organizations, and the emotional intelligence to influence without direct authority. Working knowledge of agile delivery and program governance, sufficient to partner effectively with delivery teams and hold them to outcomes. You are not expected to run the delivery machine yourself. A bachelor's degree; business, computer science, engineering or a related field preferred. Desirable An MBA or comparable postgraduate qualification. Hands-on experience shaping or scaling an AI capability, from use-case definition through adoption, in an enterprise setting. Commercial analytics depth in pricing, Revenue Growth Management or promotion effectiveness. title: Business Development Manager Dr Squatch ANZ
description: A career at Unilever is a career made by you. Here, you’ll find development opportunities, meaningful benefits, and a culture that embraces diversity and leads the way in flexible working. The brand stands for better ingredients, distinctive scents, bold personality and a more entertaining approach to personal care — helping men think differently about what they use on their skin, hair and body. Identify risks, dependencies and unlocks early, driving pragmatic solutions that keep the integration and launch plan on track. ________________________________________ Key Requirements Experience Strong commercial experience, ideally in FMCG, customer development, category strategy or business development roles. Proven track record in launching, scaling or integrating brands Strong capability in category insight, P&L thinking and data-driven storytelling. Experience working across global teams, time zones, and cultures, with the ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships and develop integrated business plans that align both global and local priorities. Core Skills Commercial Strategy & Business Development: Builds commercially robust growth plans across customers, channels, portfolio, pricing and investment Customer & Category Leadership: Translates consumer, shopper and category insight into compelling retailer propositions and execution plans. Data Literacy & Storytelling: Uses analytics to create clear recommendations, influence decisions and track performance against milestones. Cross-Functional Integration: Connects global and local teams to drive launch readiness, solve issues and maintain strong governance. Operational Discipline: Manages complexity across supply, finance, regulatory, customer and execution workstreams with pace and accountability. ________________________________________ What Awaits You at Unilever? Unilever’s culture is Human, Purposeful, and Accountable. You’ll join a dynamic, flexible, and inspiring environment where you can help shape the local success of a distinctive global brand with strong growth ambition across ANZ. You’ll benefit from: A purpose-led organisation committed to sustainability Local and global career development pathways Discounts on Unilever products Attractive employee referral rewards A supportive, inclusive, high-performance culture Unilever is recognised globally as an employer of choice—a place where people grow, thrive, and make real impact. title: Associate Maintenance Manager
description: The Associate Maintenance Manager plays a key role in driving long‑term asset health by coordinating maintenance planning, reliability activities, and daily execution. This role supports the Sr. Maintenance Manager by providing direct leadership to the Maintenance & Building Planners, while also guiding maintenance technicians within the assigned area. The Associate Maintenance Manager is responsible for ensuring effective planning, execution, and continuous improvement of all maintenance and reliability activities. This includes ensuring maintenance tasks are completed to standard, resources are properly allocated, and issues are escalated promptly to maintain safe, efficient, and reliable operations. You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet. Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Continuously strive to increase the efficiency and reliability of equipment in their area of focus. Communicate with all shifts of the maintenance team to ensure a consistent message and consistent application of all company policies, programs, rules and regulations. Support maintenance team in troubleshooting, finding/procuring parts, or escalating issues as required. Carries out periodic audits to ensure depth of work order material is adequate and works with lead and planner to ensure gaps are addressed. Ensure maintenance, quality and safety audits are carried out by the team to ensure compliance with internal requirements. Work with the maintenance & buildings planner to track breakdowns, identify chronic issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable countermeasures. Review short and medium-term plans for equipment maintenance with the maintenance manager and planners and operations team. Develop long term plans with input from the managers, supervisors and operations team and ensure execution of the plans. Working as a team with Supervisors, Maintenance team members, and Operations to plan, procure and document activities for the enhancement of machines in the assigned area. Engage vendors and OEMs for technical support, project execution, reliability improvements, and complex troubleshooting. Participate in safety and quality reviews; ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly and effectively. Support the development and execution of reliability‑centered maintenance strategies, including predictive and preventive maintenance improvements. Bias for Action. By providing consistent and near real time information, decisions can be taken quickly which leverage our resources. Building Talent & Teams. Our vision is to move to semi-autonomous teams and we require Maintenance Reliability Engineer’s with a passion for achieving results through great teamwork, an ability to teach new tools and methodologies and ensuring that you and your colleagues are fully aligned, and drawing on one another’s strengths. Accountability & Responsibility. Taking responsibility for building your team’s performance and sharing your best interventions to help support other lines’ in their improvements. Process and Organizational Design. Leverage technical knowledge and a systems approach to ensure factory lines and processes are optimally resourced (e.g. manpower ratios are efficient and sustainable). Analytical capability. Collect and analyze complex data to penetrate problems’ phenomena and understand root causes. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 2 year degree in a technical field and at least two (2) years of experience as a maintenance supervisor/coordinator in fast paced manufacturing environment. Strong troubleshooting skills Excellent communication skills Ability to coordinate and communicate with teams working different shifts across a 24/7 schedule. Experience leading a team of maintenance technicians toward a common goal Must be capable of working independently and in a team environment Experience making reliability/maintenance decisions to meet needs Proven track record of implementing improvement ideas Experience using a CMMS system Controls/Automation experience with a strong preference to Allen Bradley controls PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 4+ years of experience as a maintenance supervisor/coordinator in fast paced manufacturing environment. Foods industry experience is preferred. Pay: The pay range for this position is $88,600 to $133,000. Unilever takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. title: Process Engineer
description: JOB PURPOSE The Process Engineer is responsible for designing, optimizing, and sustaining manufacturing and utility processes to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective production. This role serves as the technical owner of process improvements and projects, supporting process performance and capability, and leading the end-to-end delivery of capital and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure stable, consistent, and controlled production operations. Working closely with Operations, Quality, R&D, Maintenance, and Engineering, the Process Engineer drives optimization of process conditions, reduces variability, and supports scale-up, technology transfer, and continuous improvement across batching, material handling, and utility systems. You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet. Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.
