title: Reliability Engineer
description: JOB PURPOSE The Reliability Engineer is responsible for improving equipment reliability, eliminating chronic losses, and stabilizing production assets through engineering-led maintenance strategies. This role sits within the Maintenance Department serves as the technical owner of loss elimination, defining asset reliability strategies and standards to transition the plant from reactive to preventive and predictive maintenance. Working closely with Maintenance and Operations, this position ensures asset strategies and improvements permanently eliminate failure modes impacting Safety, Quality, Production, and Cost. The role focuses on defining and driving reliability strategy and is not responsible for day-to-day maintenance execution. You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters – for people and the planet. Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Reliability & Loss Elimination Identify and prioritize chronic losses and bad actor assets using downtime, cost, and defect data Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent solutions to eliminate repeat failures Develop and maintain reliability strategies for critical equipment Use data to validate improvements and track results Drive prioritization of reliability efforts based on business impact (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery) Ensure solutions are sustained through standards, PMs, and procedures Maintenance Strategy & Standards Define and optimize maintenance strategies (PM, PdM, run-to-failure) based on failure modes and asset criticality Improve PM effectiveness through failure-mode-driven tasks Drive continuous improvement of maintenance plans using CMMS data and feedback Eliminate non-value-added PMs and improve maintenance efficiency Ensure maintenance strategies prevent repeat failures Develop SMPs and standards Plant Floor Engagement & Capability Building Work directly on the plant floor to validate failures and root causes Coach maintenance and operations teams in RCA and reliability thinking Partner with Operations to reduce misuse and avoidable losses Support implementation of practical, sustainable improvements Support capital projects related to fixed equipment, process improvement, utilities, and facilities Continuous Improvement & Governance Apply structured improvement methodologies (TPM/WCM, focused improvement) Embed reliability improvements into daily operations Collaborate across Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Operations Maintain reliability data to support decision-making Digital & Predictive Capability Apply condition monitoring techniques (vibration, thermography, oil analysis) Support development of predictive maintenance strategies Use data and analytics to improve asset performance Key Deliverables Reduce downtime and improve asset reliability (MTBF / MTTR / BD%, PMs ) Eliminate chronic failures and bad actors Improve effectiveness of maintenance strategies Deliver sustained improvements through data Increase capability of maintenance and operations teams REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in engineering: Mechanical, Chemical, or equivalent 5+ years of related experience in FMCG, chemical, oil & gas, pharmaceutical or automotive industry Strong predictive maintenance Familiarity with CMMS systems CAD experience (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) 3D printing or rapid prototyping experience Condition monitoring and predictive maintenance experience title: Technology Process Lead - Palletizing Systems
hiring_org: 6194 Unilever NA Sourcing West, S. de R.L. de C.V.
description: Join us as Technology Process Lead - Palletizing Systems Function: Supply Chain Reports to: Site Engineering Manager Scope: Local Location: Nuevo León Terms & Conditions: Full time. Permanent Contract Role Summary The Technology Lead – Palletizing Systems is the technical owner of all automatic palletizing equipment across the manufacturing site. This role is responsible for defining the technology roadmap, standardizing equipment, improving system reliability, maximizing Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and designing robust, operator-centric solutions that improve safety, productivity, and ease of operation. The Technology Lead partners closely with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, Quality, Supply Chain, Safety, and external OEMs to develop sustainable engineering solutions while promoting a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, technical excellence, and manufacturing standardization. Key Responsibilities Own the technical strategy for all palletizing systems. Develop and maintain engineering standards, specifications, and best practices. Lead equipment reliability and continuous improvement initiatives to maximize OEE. Design simple, robust, and user-friendly systems that reduce operator intervention and human error. Standardize equipment architecture, spare parts, automation philosophy, and maintenance practices. Lead root cause analysis of chronic failures and implement permanent corrective actions. Support capital projects from concept through commissioning and startup. Work closely with operators to understand operational challenges and translate them into engineering improvements. Coach and mentor maintenance technicians and engineers on palletizing technology. Collaborate with OEMs to implement best-in-class solutions. Ensure all designs comply with safety, ergonomic, and manufacturing standards. Drive predictive and preventive maintenance strategies. Define long-term technology roadmaps aligned with business objectives. Leadership Expectations Lead through technical expertise and influence. Build strong cross-functional relationships. Foster teamwork and knowledge sharing. Promote engineering excellence and a continuous improvement mindset. Develop technical capability across the organization. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automation & Control Engineering, or related field. 3+ years of proven experience with automatic palletizing systems. Demonstrated experience leading complex equipment improvement projects. Strong knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, robotics, servo systems, conveyors, and industrial automation. Experience in TPM, Lean Manufacturing, Reliability Engineering, and OEE improvement. Excellent communication, leadership, and project management skills. Success Metrics OEE improvement. Equipment availability. MTBF and MTTR performance. Reduction of chronic failures. Standardization implementation. Safety performance. Capital project execution.
